title.fr: Cohésion du noyau et interaction forte

formula: R = R₀ · A^(1/3) ;  E_ℓ = Δm · c²   (courbe E_ℓ/A vs A)
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a "nucleus" visualization — a cluster of
protons (red) and neutrons (blue), radius R = R₀·A^(1/3). Sliders:
Z, N. Two force-magnitude bars in the HUD: strong nuclear attraction
(short-range, saturates with A) vs. Coulomb repulsion (long-range,
grows with Z²). A second panel overlays the semi-empirical binding-
energy-per-nucleon curve E_ℓ/A vs. A (peak near A≈56 Fe/Ni region)
with a moving marker at the student's current (Z, N). Experiment:
reach maximum E_ℓ/A by tuning Z, N; observe how strong>Coulomb
corresponds to bound nuclei. Evaluate: bars + curve hidden; student
predicts stable/unstable and estimates the position on the B/A curve
from Z, N alone. Wrinkle: 3ème-level qualitative — no MeV numbers,
just the visual/relational story. Feeds into Bac fission/fusion.
